book.name: Filemon
book.title: Filemon Polho Filemontha bapiya ngo irim togoc

content: Noc Pol, nocho Duic Yesuha tongga ngo yi bucin itat. Oro nocot oröc noni Timoti, notho bapiya ngo irim tongo sidaya goc Filemon youp kondong nucnoti orin oröc noti gocot ongeyac.
O ihorocgon owi amna gocho bucin suran tongidangma orin nat nodi Apia orin Arkipus yu ambaracha bapiya ngo sidaya ongeyac. Arkipus yu emoc amna simbang Duichon youp orongi sinom tongitac.
Kopotoroc Nandöng noni, orin Yesu Duic, yuho kang banaunya irot gucno sonot itun.
Polho Filemonthon toroc kiap ogepma wo angga borongdedoc

Filemon, nocho gochon fat ingoroc kombingitat: Goc Moröm noni Yesu yuha toup sinom kombing tobing imongitaroc. O gocu Kopotorochon owi amna irot tong fup imongitaroc. Worocha tongga nocu dönac yongo gakain toroc kiap ogepmaha kombingmaina Kopotoroc ecec moröma sinom inongitat.
Nocu wömai dönac ingoroc yongitat: Nontho gocot kondong itmanaina kombing tobic tobic nonihon matano inun ganun tongo Duichon manomano ogepma fogitdegomonma woroc kombicno sinom tonahamon.

Oröcna, gocho Kopotorochon owi amna irot boging imongitaroc. Tongo nocho kiap worochon fatno kombingmaina borongdeda gocha irot ogep moröma sinom kombihat. Boinno, gochon toroc kiap ogepmaho tuna kunkun owi amnaho gesö wego sogitmuya irotno borongdetno sinom tang.
Polho Onesimusha Filemon dönac inogoc
Worochai oro, yapmu tungu au wömai nocho ‘goc muyu tiruc’ yongo kiring gampiwa. Duicha tongga gocho nochon manana öngkuboroc. Worocha tongga noc ogep ‘ihoroc toi’ yongo nongoru ganam mahong
nocho gocha toup kombihatmaha kiring gamoc gamocha makombit. Muno nocu komanang mata obingo gantiwa. Noc Pol, noc amna basi, o Duicha tongga nocho ngo yi bucin itatma,
nocho manana Onesimus ‘yuha’ yongo dönac gantiwa. Noc yi bucin edeya yuho irotno ibaruna nocho Duichon madec yuhon fano öngkubot.
Osuc wömai yu gakain youp wabkarac etno itmuna angit matongfat gengidoc mahong önga wömai yui mongurac tongga gocot nocot tongfatnec noti ogepma sinom itac.
Oro önga wömai yu nakain irotna koburo sinom itac mahong muyu, nocho yu wönggon gocot inong muhat.
Fatmata ogepmaha tongga noc ngo yi bucin itat. Tongo ‘yu gakain abam sogida nocot ngocin ida mongorec tong namun’ yongo toup kombihat
mahong noc nakabut mayam. Muno, goc gakain irot tanda kiap ihorocnoha tongfat necnecha kombiyai wömai kiap ihorocno angit entac. Noc worocha mata orongi maganit.
Noc ingoroc kombihat: Onesimus yu wömai bongono docutno-hagon gocha korungon idoc. Worocha tongga gocho yu wönggon sogida kömbaha gakaot engochu nuhun?

Osuc wömai yui gochon youp wabkarac boyömo idoc mahong önga wömai yui gakain oröca öngkuboc. Mayain nocu yuha toup kombingitat. Yui gochon youp wabkarac ogepma sinom orin Moröma noniha tongga gochon oröca sinom öngkubocmaha tongga yuho gocot ehuna gocho yuha ihorocgon toup sinom kombiangoroc.
Oro, gocu nocha kombiiya noc gochon youp kondong nuca itatanu wömai goc muyu Onesimus gocho bucin yangat töngga toroc kiap ogepma indairuc, kiapmo noc nindarimma worocotma yu indairuc.
Oro yu toroc kiap wömuno tong gamogochu o yapmu au usem togocmahu wömai naniya nocho tong bumbum worochon urago wuangot.

Noc Pol, noc mata ngo nakain obunadec irim tat: “Nocho urago wuangot.” Wohong kombihi, gakain itonggong woi nakain youpha öngkuboc. Worocha wömai gochon butogo idina gocho noc urago namim. Wohong nocu worochon mata mayit.
Oröcna, nocho dönac ganotma worochon toroc toi. Ihoroc tontarocanu wömai ogepma sinom tongfat neia irotna gucno in.
Noc mata ngo irim tongmaina boinno sinom kombihat, goc nakain mata sumboda noc dönac ganotma worochon toroc tangoroc. O worocgon muno ogepma sinom tongfat neangoroc.

Oro, mata au ingoroc gantiwa: Noc kombihat, Kopotorocho gochon dönac kombingmuna worochon toroc noc tongfat neuna noc orung ida gocot ehangot. Worocha tongga gocu ‘nocha’ yongga gakain böc irotno au tong arangarang tia itun.
Oro, Epapras yui ihorocgon Duic Yesuha tongga nocot yi böc ngocin idamot. Yui irot ogep matano siuna gocot epac.
O youp kondongna Mak, Aristarkus, Demas o Luk, yui ihorocgon gocha yongo irot ogep matano siuya ongeyac.
Moröm noni Yesu Duic yuhon banac banacno soniot itun.
